headline: Turkey Wealth Fund to Become Largest Shareholder in Togg
summary: The Türkiye Wealth Fund is set to become the largest shareholder in Turkish electric carmaker Togg after restructuring the company's ownership following stake sales by Vestel and Anadolu.
why: State-backed investment funds frequently take strategic stakes in key domestic manufacturing and technology champions to support industrial policy.

impacts.name: Togg
impacts.why: Ownership restructuring alters the governance and capital structure of the electric vehicle maker.
